opportunities.title: Hakluyt Society Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to researchers preparing publication proposals to be submitted to the Society, or researching approved projects under contract. Recipients of support need not be members of the Society.
opportunities.summary: Research support paid as reimbursements of previously agreed expenditure (from the Harry & Grace Smith Fund) for research in support of preparing publication projects for submission to the Society (Category A) or research towards completion of approved projects under contract (Category B). Eligible research relates to volumes for the main series (currently Series III) or the Hakluyt Society Studies in the History of Travel series.
